title: Lesche stability of the Shannon strong hyperbolic entropy and some hyperbolic extensions
summary: In recent decades, several definitions of new entropy measures have been proposed, which expands the range of applications for this important tool. The present work focuses on the extension of the classical Shannon entropy to the hyperbolic number plane $\mathbb{D}$ with the notion of valued hyperbolic probability.
